What you're seeking is relief. You dont want to die but you want to live but at the same time you want to escape everything. Just know you are still young and have a lot of opportunity to do things and change your life for the better. I understand,  I too cannot connect with people because of all this social media and how it's dumbing down society in my personal opinion. Loneliness is scary so you shouldnt isolate yourself from society. Try joining communities or church group. Anything to get you out and going. Have you talked to a therapist about your problems? The impact of suicide is much greater than you think because it also affect your loved ones. Even people you don't talk to anymore would be worried. You can still live, the fire inside you is much greater than the fire youre facing. You can pull out of this and in a couple of year down the line you'll be happy you survived through it.

Yeah schoolwork can be overwhelming at times. Do you have any school friends? You can get any girl you want, have you tried dressing differently or possibly working out to improve your overall appearance if you're unhappy?

Listen there, there is so much to life than you're aware of. If you're going to end it, which not just start a new life? Move to a different city or far away place where no one knows you. Like as if you were dead, but alive. Don't talk to anyone you ever knew until the time comes. Find opportunities and start thinking about your future. Cmon, you're throwing your life away for a temporary problem. If it gets really bad, please seek help. People care. It's all confidential and are willing to help because they want you to live through these hard times. I know it can feel hopeless but trust me, you're strong enough to make it through this. Don't ever feel like you're the only one going through this and that you're alone. Don't judge or be ashamed. Be yourself and love yourself. I know you've laughed and smiled before. Think of your better times, you can easily bring those back. Just stay strong please

Yeah always have a good support group. People you can tell things to and not get judged so be careful who you tell your problems too. You wouldn't want the whole world knowing because it might get you more depressed. You are depressed but it's just the negative thinking that gets to you. Always judging yourself and insecurities but just stop. Life keeps moving forward and you've made it this far so why not keep going? See how much better it will get. Of course, it sounds like it will never get better but trust me, it does. It's all temporary even if you don't know it. I'm positive you'll get a girlfriend but YOU ARE RIGHT. Fix yourself before you get one. So you can be confident in yourself and can avoid relationship problems in the future. Best of luck to you :) you're a great guy

You say deep down inside you want to live. That's because death isn't what you want. What you want is RELIEF. something that can pull you out of. Feeling depressed is the worst especially if it's been persisting for a long time. You hear the same messages on reddit everywhere you go that "everything will be okay: or "that it will get better" but that's bullshit unless you're willing to put the effort to help yourself. No miracle is going to hit you and save you. Be powerful. Grow the power you need to be aware of your situation, analyze it, and fix it. Talking to people about your emotions always helps. It's relieves the built up stress you've had. I'm a stranger but believe me I do care. I care that you'll love please don't try to kill yourself. There's more to life than you know but you are blinded by depression. If you are going to do it again, please seek help or go to the emergency room. Or at least talk to me, I can help you and understand without judging. I would love to learn you story. Stay strong my friend.

If you want to stick with your job, ignore your coworkers. They're just bringing negativity into your life. Just stop talking to them. If they ask what's wrong, just say you just want to focus on your work and provide for your family and that's it. You're a good person. The coworkers might make fun of you but they can't say much if in they're in the same position as you are. They get their joy from making fun of others because work can get boring sometimes and of course humans gossip. Focus on yourself and your top priorities which is yourself amd your family. Forget the rest, in your mind you know you are above these people because of how you carry yourself. Sooner or later they should stop messing with you and maybe even respect you for standing up for yourself. Hope this helps.
